_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live since 2022-11-30 and already repricing obvious losers (Chegg, 2023-05-02), but the sell-side read for ACN was share gain (J.P.Morgan, 2023-02-10) and the stock trades at 24.1x FY23E — near its own median, not an AI discount. Re-file under AI_EXPOSED only when the multiple starts discounting the legacy-services deflation J.P.Morgan describes, or it shows up in managed-services growth.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: #1-scale IT-services and consulting franchise that took share through the cloud cycle; discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.85x; +34% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.14; conservative 2yr +4%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY12-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +6.8%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.8%/yr (FY12-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +16.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2023-05-12) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.85x (27.1% downside to Bear $202 / +32.0% upside to Bull $366) | Adj composite 3.07 vs market 2.93: gap +0.14 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +34% above the EPP floor $207 (18x FY23E $11.52) | Conservative 2-yr case: +3.7% total (+1.9%/yr) | At 24.1x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $367 sits above the BULL case; consulting +4% LC in Q2, Q3 guided +3-7% LC; GenAI is a live theme, read by the sell side as share gain for consultancies, not a threat.
